title: Recovery: Integrations
summary: Use graves with maps, weather checks, route records, spare kits, and travel tools.

blocks.title: Connected Systems
blocks.body: WorldCore explains hazard context, HoloMap marks the path, WeatherCore can delay unsafe returns, and Logistics can stage spare kits.

blocks.title: Practical Pairings
blocks.body: Use HoloMap markers, Armory spare loadouts, Logistics recovery kits, WorldCore hazard context, and TutorialCore repeated-death coaching.

blocks.title: Fallback Play
blocks.body: Without map or travel helpers, write the coordinates, pack light, and prepare one clean retrieval route instead of sprinting back blind.

blocks.title: Fallback Check
blocks.body: If the helper addon is absent, keep the same order by hand and follow the manual checkpoint.
